articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: S&P 500 Rises As Oil Sinks On Iran Talk Hopes: Stock Market Today
articles.summary: Crude fell about 4% on renewed US-Iran talk hopes, easing yields and fueling a broad rally in real estate, homebuilders and airlines.
articles._summary: U.S. stocks rose at midday Friday in a broad-based rally, with the Dow up around 0.5% and the S&P 500 gaining 0.4%, as a roughly 4% slide in oil prices cooled the inflation and rate-hike anxieties that had gripped markets all week. The Wall Street Journal reported that Bahrain and Kuwait warplanes had struck sites inside Iran, and Iranian commanders issued fresh threats, even as Pakistan and Iran were said to be exploring a China-brokered path back to talks with Washington.
articles._zh_headline: 伊朗会谈希望导致油价下跌，标普 500 指数上涨：今日股市
articles._zh_summary: 周五中午，美国股市普遍上涨，道琼斯指数上涨约 0.5%，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.4%，油价下跌约 4% 缓解了整周困扰市场的通胀和加息忧虑。 《华尔街日报》报道称，巴林和科威特战机袭击了伊朗境内的地点，伊朗指挥官发出了新的威胁，尽管据称巴基斯坦和伊朗正在探索一条在中国斡旋下与华盛顿谈判的道路。

articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: Intel's $90 Billion Wipeout Sparks 20% Crash In These ETFs
articles.summary: Intel stock erased a $90 billion rally, sending LINT and INTW ETFs down more than 20% and highlighting the risks of leveraged investing.
articles._summary: A dramatic post-earnings reversal erased nearly $90 billion in market value in less than 24 hours. The reversal comes amid elevated volatility across semiconductor stocks, with investors reassessing AI-related valuations and earnings expectations. After surging as much as 15% in after-hours trading following its quarterly earnings report on Wednesday, Intel shares gave up all those gains and more by Friday, falling 4% on the day.
articles._zh_headline: 英特尔 900 亿美元的损失导致这些 ETF 暴跌 20%
articles._zh_summary: 财报公布后的戏剧性逆转在不到 24 小时内蒸发了近 900 亿美元的市值。这一逆转发生在半导体股票波动加剧之际，投资者重新评估与人工智能相关的估值和盈利预期。周三公布季度收益报告后，英特尔股价在盘后交易中飙升 15%，但到周五回吐了所有涨幅，当天下跌 4%。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: Oil Broke $100, Alphabet's AI Bill Scares Investors: What Moved Wall Street This Week
articles.summary: Brent crude topped $100 as Middle East tensions escalated while Alphabet and Tesla sold off on surging AI spending.
articles._summary: Two of America’s largest companies reported earnings this week. Neither was punished for what it sold . Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) lost $294 billion in market value on Thursday, the largest single-session loss in the company’s history. Tesla Inc. (NASDAQ: TSLA ) suffered its worst week since March 2020. Underneath both selloffs sat the same line item: CAPEX. Above it all, Brent crude climbed above $100 a barrel for the first time since May.
articles._zh_headline: 石油突破 100 美元，Alphabet 的人工智能法案吓坏了投资者：本周是什么让华尔街感动
articles._zh_summary: 美国最大的两家公司本周公布了收益。两人都没有因为所售商品而受到惩罚。 Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOGL）周四市值损失 2940 亿美元，这是该公司历史上最大的单日损失。特斯拉公司（纳斯达克股票代码：TSLA）经历了自 2020 年 3 月以来最糟糕的一周。两次抛售背后隐藏着同一个项目：资本支出。最重要的是，布伦特原油自 5 月份以来首次升至每桶 100 美元以上。

articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: Wall Street's New ETF Strategy? Copy, Paste, Repeat—and Hope for the Next DRAM
articles.summary: Everyone wants the next DRAM. See why ETF issuers are cloning winning AI and semiconductor themes—and what it means for investors.
articles._summary: The U.S. ETF industry’s hottest product is no longer just a blockbuster fund, it’s the copycat. A record 1,084 ETFs had launched by mid-July, already within striking distance of 2025’s full-year record of 1,161, per Morningstar. With U.S.-listed ETF inflows on pace to reach $2.3 trillion this year, as estimated by State Street, issuers are racing to capture the next winning investment theme before rivals do. And interestingly, a successful ETF doesn’t just attract assets, it spawns an entire category.
articles._zh_headline: 华尔街的新ETF策略？复制、粘贴、重复——期待下一代 DRAM
articles._zh_summary: 美国ETF行业最热门的产品不再只是重磅基金，而是山寨基金。根据晨星公司的数据，截至 7 月中旬，已推出创纪录的 1,084 只 ETF，距离 2025 年全年记录 1,161 只已经很近了。据道富银行估计，今年美国上市 ETF 的流入量将达到 2.3 万亿美元，发行人正在竞相抢在竞争对手之前抓住下一个成功的投资主题。有趣的是，成功的 ETF 不仅能吸引资产，还能催生整个类别。

articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: Sam Altman's Eye-Scanning ID Startup World Just Raised $52.5 Million, Even as Nvidia Chip Shortages Slow Its Rollout
articles.summary: Sam Altman-backed World raised $52.5 million through a Worldcoin token sale backed by major crypto investors under lockup.
articles._summary: World , the online identity-verification venture co-founded by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman , raised $52.5 million through a token sale of Worldcoin (CRYPTO: WLD) on Friday, drawing strategic investors under a 12-month lockup. World, operated by Tools for Humanity and led by CEO Alex Blania , verifies users through Orb devices that scan their irises to issue a World ID. The digital identity is designed to distinguish real people from bots online.
articles._zh_headline: Sam Altman 的眼部扫描 ID 初创公司 World 刚刚筹集了 5250 万美元，尽管 Nvidia 芯片短缺减缓了其推出速度
articles._zh_summary: OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 联合创立的在线身份验证企业 World 于周五通过 Worldcoin（加密货币代码：WLD）代币销售筹集了 5250 万美元，吸引了战略投资者进行 12 个月的锁定。 World 由 Tools for Humanity 运营并由首席执行官 Alex Blania 领导，通过 Orb 设备验证用户，扫描用户的虹膜以颁发 World ID。数字身份旨在区分真人与在线机器人。
